**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 14:50
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant can help understand generating static params in Next.js 13.2 with examples using TypeScript.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dynamic routes in Next.js are used when the exact route path is not known ahead of time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] `generateStaticParams` is a function used in combination with dynamic route segments to define the list of route segment parameters that will be statically generated at build time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] An example of a dynamic route is `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, where `[slug]` is the dynamic segment for blog post URLs.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a code example for the `page.tsx` file defining the page component:
  ```typescript
  // app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx

  import React from 'react';

  interface PageProps {
    params: {
      slug: string;
    };
  }

  const Page: React.FC<PageProps> = ({ params }) => {
    const { slug } = params;
    return <div>Post with slug: {slug}</div>;
  };

  export default Page;
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The `generateStaticParams` function will fetch data and return an array of `params` objects with the slugs of the blog posts.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a code example for the `generateStaticParams` function:
  ```typescript
  // app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx

  import type { GenerateStaticParams } from 'next';

  interface Params {
    slug: string;
  }

  export const generateStaticParams: GenerateStaticParams<Params> = async () => {
    const response = await fetch('https://.../posts');
    const posts = await response.json();

    return posts.map((post: { slug: string }) => ({
      slug: post.slug,
    }));
  };
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] During the build process, Next.js will call the `generateStaticParams` function, fetch the list of posts, and create a static version of the page for each post with the corresponding slug.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The `generateStaticParams` function runs at build time, and the data fetching is automatically deduplicated.
- [USER] The user requested more detailed examples and suggested using any free API to create a more detailed example to understand its working practically.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested using the JSONPlaceholder API to create a more detailed example for a simple blog app that fetches posts and users from the API.
